items.title: Permanence of quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness for algebraic spaces

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with three assertions: a morphism from a quasi-compact space to a quasi-separated one is quasi-compact; if moreover the source is quasi-separated then the morphism is quasi-compact and quasi-separated; and a fibre product of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces is again quasi-compact and quasi-separated (source lines 1473-1485). Part (1) specialises the permanence lemma for triangles over Spec(Z); part (2) combines (1) with the composition statement for separatedness; part (3) shows that the projection of the fibre product is quasi-compact and quasi-separated as a base change, and then deduces the two properties for the fibre product itself from the corresponding over-the-base statements.
